description: Governed data corrections, decided by the data owner on 2026-10-01. Each correction derives the missing master or register records from the rows that reference them, so every value is traceable to a source row. Corrections are applied when data is loaded into the system of record (Supabase seed, Dataverse provisioning) and logged per row; the governed workbook and the v9.15 runtime datasets are left unchanged.

corrections.title: Add the historical asset series to the asset master
corrections.decision: The AST-H series (tags such as SP-01-INV-H01) numbers assets with one portfolio-wide sequence and its own tag codes (TRA, WEA, SWI), so it cannot be matched to existing assets. Each historical asset is added to the master from its intervention record.

data_basis.template: Added by data correction C1 from intervention {intervention_id} / work order {work_order_id}

corrections.title: Add the CBM and RCA case assets to the asset master
corrections.decision: CBM and RCA cases use a per-plant asset naming (SP01-INV-A01, ARV-INV-204, DEC-INV-411, VIN-TRF-709). Plant, tag and class agree across all four sheets that use them, so each is added to the master under its own ID.

data_basis.template: Added by data correction C2 from CBM assessment {cbm_assessment_id}

corrections.title: Create the planned work orders referenced by planning
corrections.decision: Work orders WO-20xxx and WO-40xxx are referenced by five planning sheets but missing from the register. Each is created as a scheduled work order from its intervention: same asset, plant, type and priority; created at the planning date, due at the required-by date.

data_basis.template: Created by data correction C3 from intervention {intervention_id} (planning status {planning_status})
